messages:
Rita (CS): Brightline final prep: Dedicated pool activation tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need last-minute checks: quota gates, autoscale thresholds, shadow-surge rehearsal, and KMS key rotation window.
Noah - Infra: I'll verify the reserved quota is actually attached to their org_id. Last time billing tag missed a label.
Lena (AE): Customer committed to a steady 250k tokens/min and wants a 45-minute burst window to 450k at launch. Renewal note: they mentioned SLA + cost review in 30 days.
Sam (SRE): For graceful degradation, prefer staged shedding: (1) reject low-priority requests, (2) route to cheaper model, (3) degrade rate limit per token. I'll prototype rate-tier config.
Diego (QA): Planning two rehearsals: shadow-surge at 06:30 UTC (synthetic only) and controlled burst at 07:40 UTC (with customer). I'll run both with telemetry on and capture p50/p95/p99 + 5xx.
Rita (CS): Also capture feedback on prompt latency from their SDK. They use chunked streaming so we need to validate chunk latency under cache-warm.
Noah - Infra: Autoscale draft I pushed to infra-config:
```yaml
pool: brightline-dedicated
autoscale:
  min_gpus: 6
  target_tokens_per_gpu_per_min: 18000
  max_gpus: 32
  scale_cooldown: 120s
  burst_window: 2700s # 45m
  burst_multiplier: 1.8
  fallback_model: redwood-lite-quant
  shed_policy: ["low_priority", "model_fallback", "rate_limit"]
```
Sam (SRE): Good. Add `graceful_shutdown_wait: 30s` so in-flight requests have a short drain. Also schedule maintenance blackout for 05:00-12:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Note: Blackout window applied to cluster-north-1 for 05:00-12:00 UTC.
Lena (AE): Billing confirmed quota reservation: reserved_units=150 (maps to 250k tokens/min). I'll DM billing to confirm label sync.
Rita (CS): KMS rotation: they requested rotation at T+2 days after go-live. @kms-bot can you confirm auto-rotation compatibility with dedicated pools?
kms-bot: KMS check: key-rotations supported. Need a 15-minute maintenance handoff window and test re-encryption on startup. See https://intra.redwood.ai/kms-dedicated for steps.
Diego (QA): Traffic profiles: 65% chat/generation, 25% embeddings, 10% rerank. Using k6 + our tokeniser shim. Will attach results here.
Noah - Infra: Enabling KV priming for top-10 routes to reduce tail 1. Will pre-warm during shadow-surge.
Sam (SRE): Alerting: create two pagers: severity-1 for >2% 5xx or p95 > 900ms sustained for 3m, severity-2 for >1% 5xx or p95 > 600ms for 5m. If alerts fire, automatic fallback to `redwood-lite-quant` and reduce burst multiplier to 1.2.
Rita (CS): Renewal risk flag: customer asked about token-cost optimization. Add follow-up: Redwood Optimize consult 2 weeks post go-live. Capturing this as action item.
Diego (QA): Shadow-surge run finished, summary: sustained 260k tokens/min for 20m, p95=420ms, 5xx=0.4%. Attaching logs snippet: `errors: 4 / 1000`
Noah - Infra: Nice. Pushed a KV cache tweak; priming hit rate improved from 12% to 63% in initial window.
Lena (AE): Customer test (07:40 UTC) scheduled. I'll join their call to capture subjective latency feedback.
Rita (CS): Final checklist for tomorrow:
- Billing label confirmation (Lena)
- Autoscale PR merged (Noah)
- SRE alert rules applied (Sam)
- QA runs and logs posted (Diego)
- KMS rotation plan approved (kms-bot, Noah)
- Customer SDK smoke test (Lena/Rita)
Please mark if blocked. :white_check_mark: 
Noah - Infra: PR merged, tagging infra-oncall for 02:00 UTC review.
Sam (SRE): If we see >1% 5xx during the customer run, we'll initiate canary rollback to warm pool and open incident.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: brightline-canary-03 at 07:00 UTC. Results will be posted to #eng-releases.
Diego (QA): Will post full CSV and a short summary in 25m. If anyone wants a specific metric captured, call it out now.
Rita (CS): Thanks team. I'll post go/no-go after the customer smoke test and capture any immediate feedback for the renewal thread.
